requests.ask: FX1-A-10: limits.mjs peerKey reads only the dotted '::ffff:a.b.c.d' form as IPv4. IPv4-mapped addresses written in hex or full form ('::ffff:c633:6407', '0:0:0:0:0:ffff:198.51.100.7') all key to '0:0:0:0::/64', so their callers share one rate-limit bucket. Fix: expand the address to eight groups (a dotted tail counts as two); if the first five are 0 and the sixth is ffff, key it as the dotted IPv4; otherwise take the /64 as now. Flip test 'FX1-A-10' in server/test/fix_fx1_audit_server_a.test.mjs with the fix.
requests.default: Assign to a task that owns limits.mjs
